warnings.detail: All 23 stories lack a requirements_covered field mapping to FR IDs. Traceability exists at epic/feature level but not story level. This makes it harder to verify 100% FR coverage at the story level.
warnings.recommendation: Add requirements_covered array to each story (e.g., US-015 → [FR-03, FR-21]).

warnings.description: FR-13 (BridgeNow Product Tag) not explicitly covered by any story
warnings.detail: EP-03 lists FR-13 in its requirements but no story AC explicitly mentions tagging applications with 'BridgeNow' product type. This may be implicit in US-015 (application creation) but should be explicit.
warnings.recommendation: Add an AC to US-015 or US-018: 'Given the selected product is BridgeNow, When the application is created, Then it is tagged with productType=BridgeNow'.

warnings.detail: FR-18 requires the decision engine to check existing BridgeNow exposure. US-027 covers exposure limits but doesn't explicitly mention checking for existing active BridgeNow loans.
warnings.recommendation: Add an AC to US-027: 'Given the applicant has an existing active BridgeNow loan, When the exposure check runs, Then the combined exposure is validated against the limit'.

warnings.description: FR-09 (Zero Early Closure Fee) in EP-03 scope but is a Sprint 3 feature
warnings.detail: EP-03 requirements_covered includes FR-09 (zero early closure fee). The offer display (US-030) shows 'No Early Closure' banner, but the actual settlement flow with zero fee is Sprint 3 (F-04.3). The Sprint 2 scope is correct (display only), but the FR mapping is misleading.
warnings.recommendation: Clarify that Sprint 2 implements the display/configuration aspect of FR-09, while Sprint 3 implements the execution aspect.

warnings.description: No story for application status tracking screen
warnings.detail: The state machine has 9 Sprint 2 states (Draft→Active) but no story explicitly covers an 'Application Status' screen where the customer can see their application progress through these states.
warnings.recommendation: Consider adding a story for an application status/tracker screen, or confirm this is deferred to Sprint 3 dashboard.

warnings.description: US-037 creates a Loans table entry but BL5 doesn't list Loans as Sprint 2
warnings.detail: US-037 (disbursement) transitions the application to 'Active' which implies creating a Loans record. BL5 lists the Loans table as Sprint 3. Either the disbursement story should NOT create the Loans record (just mark application as Disbursed), or BL5 should be updated.
warnings.recommendation: Clarify: does disbursement create a Loans record or just update application status? If Loans record is needed, move Loans table to Sprint 2 in BL5.
